nom: PEACH & LILY Overnight Star Night Cream

segments.oily: Some reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin find the cream works well without breakouts or greasiness, though a couple say it feels too intense on oily areas like the forehead.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including those in dry climates, most often report deep overnight hydration and softer skin by morning, though a few found it insufficiently moisturizing or too thick to absorb.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report no breakouts and improvement in dry patches, with one finding it too heavy to use on the face despite liking it for neck and chest.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly describe the cream as soothing and non-irritating even with rosacea or eczema-like flare-ups, but some report burning, irritation, or breakouts from the fragrance or acai extract.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s-70s report improved texture, bounce, and glow, and describe it as an effective intensive moisturizer for aging, dry winter skin.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother texture, more bounce, and a healthier glow with regular use; one reviewer in her mid-30s reports reduced visibility of fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong overnight hydration with soft, plump, non-greasy skin by morning; a minority say it did not moisturize enough or left skin drier through the day, especially when paired with retinoid use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers using it for redness-prone or rosacea skin report calming effects and reduced redness; one notes it works especially well when kept in the fridge.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers using retinoids or exfoliants report the cream helped prevent peeling, flaking, and dryness and kept their moisture barrier intact overnight.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots and acne scars with regular use over weeks; no negative reports specific to this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even lightened blemishes; however, others report frequent breakouts or that the product is unsuitable for those prone to clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream absorbs well and does not feel greasy overall, though some found specific oily areas like the forehead overwhelmed by the richness.

extraits.texte: As someone who uses a retinoid, I need a heavy duty moisturizer. This does not cut it. I wake up with dry skin that gets more parched throughout the day. I have to layer this with other sleeping masks, which defeats it's purpose. Hard pass.

extraits.titre: Really great if you have very very dry skin!
extraits.texte: This product is deeply hydrating. I used to have these dry patches on my nose that drove me crazy, but the overnight star cream fixed those patches right up! I will say for me personally it was a bit too intense for my more oily areas like my forehead, but if you are looking for a deeply norishing and sensitive skin friendly moisturizer this is a great option.

As someone with acne-prone skin who uses a nightly prescription retinol, I have always struggled with redness, dryness, and the worst unsightly skin flaking/peeling during the dry winter months. Then I found this product, and WOW has it been a game changer for me! The peeling has virtually disappeared, the redness has improved, and my skin looks hydrated and smooth when I wake up. All of this without triggering any break-outs! I love the thick texture and the lavender scent. A little really does go a long way- I apply all over my face and neck every night and I probably use about a third of the jar a month. This is totally a winter holy grail product for me now!

It takes very little of this to moisture and hydrate face, neck, and chest. Just get the tiniest little bit, rub it in your hands to melt it really well, and apply in upward strokes. My skin is oily, sensitive, and lightly aging. This moisturizer has worked with several different serums and treatments, and has never given me problems. I've been using for six months, and I've only used HALF the jar. Worth every penny.

This is one of the best moisturizers I have ever used! I have combination, sensitive, acne prone skin which gets dry after I use my prescription retinoid. Overnight Star helps prevent my skin peeling from dryness in the wintertime, and keeps it hydrated and soothed in summertime. I appreciate that the packaging is glass and recyclable/reusable. There is no blue cast when I put this moisturizer on, but I use it at night so it wouldn't matter to me if there was. I will buy this until I die & I wish they made a jumbo/value size.

Skincare is a journey, and sometimes that journey leads you to discover what not to put on your skin. I think my skin did not like the acai berry extract in this product, as the product broke me out frequently. I have since gone back to a favorite moisturizer. Some comments mention a dislike for the feel and fragrance of the product. I had no issues with either of these. I really liked the feel of the product on my skin, and I found the fragrance pleasant.

I've had some type of eczema (?) on my upper eye and eyelid for the last few years. It always shows up during winter. It looks like red elephant skin, it burns and sheds. Sounds terrible right? It sucks. I put this cream on there and it calmed it down. It's the first cream that's ever done anything noticeable and I've tried everything. It burned when i put it on, like literally everything else does, but the next day the skin was so calm comparatively. If it keeps it up (which is has) then this is what I'll use as long as they make it. For those who just have dry skin, which I do too, it's also really nice on the rest of my face.
